items.reason: Recorded in Botanical Garden of University of Münster, Germany.
Real-time insect detection with bounding-box F1 evaluation is central.
Abstract and method describe detection and tracking; clusters tracked, trajectories annotated.
Insect vs non-insect cluster heuristic is part of detection, not an image classification task.
Proposes own non-deep event clustering algorithm, compared with YOLOv7 and EVPropNet.
Authors recorded 31 videos themselves with their RGB-DVS system.
Dataset self-generated for this study; no existing named public dataset used.
